transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I came in because things have gotten pretty out of hand at work. I went from starting nonstop plant redesign projects, calling suppliers after hours, rewriting the shift plan myself… and now I suddenly can’t keep up with all the plans I put in motion. It’s become too much.
Have you recently experienced a period where you felt extremely happy or irritable and had a lot of energy?

Yes. At the start of this assignment, I felt almost… electrically upbeat, like I had this huge burst of energy and everything seemed obvious to me. But I also got really irritable. If anyone questioned my ideas, it felt like they were slowing down something important that needed to happen right away.
Are you currently feeling sad or empty most of the day?
Yes. Lately I wake up in the temporary apartment and I just feel this heavy, hollow feeling. It’s like the day is already ruined before I even get in the car to drive to the plant.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t heard voices or seen things that other people couldn’t see.
How long have you been feeling this heavy, hollow feeling?
About three months now. It’s been there most days, and since the move and this plant assignment, it’s gotten a lot harder to manage.
Did you have a period where you didn't need much sleep and still felt rested?

Yes. There was a stretch where I was only sleeping maybe two or three hours a night, but I’d still get up and go to the plant feeling sharp and charged. It felt like sleep was optional, almost inefficient.
How long did this extremely happy and energetic period last at the start of your assignment?

It was around three weeks ago, when I moved into the temporary apartment. That’s when things really shifted into that overdrive feeling, and then it’s been like swinging from that to barely functioning since then.
Did you ever hear voices or see things that weren't there during those three weeks when you felt extremely happy and energetic?
No, I don’t think so. I didn’t hear voices or see things that weren’t there. It was more like I felt really energized, but not like I was hallucinating.
Have you heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't since you started feeling this heavy, hollow feeling?
No, I haven’t noticed anything like that. I haven’t been hearing voices or seeing things other people couldn’t. It’s more just been this heavy feeling.
Have you experienced any strange or unusual thoughts since you started feeling this heavy, hollow feeling?
I’m not really sure what would count as strange or unusual. I haven’t noticed anything like, clearly bizarre thoughts. It’s mostly just felt empty and heavy, if that makes sense.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't when you were feeling this heavy, hollow feeling?
No, not that I can remember. When I’ve felt that hollow, heavy feeling, I haven’t been hearing voices or seeing things others couldn’t.
Have you ever had thoughts that you think aren't your own when you're feeling this heavy, hollow feeling?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t had the sense that thoughts are being put in my head or that they’re not mine. It’s more like my own thoughts just feel heavy or hard to sit with.
Did you engage in any risky or impulsive behaviors during that three-week period when you felt extremely happy and energetic?
I’m not really sure. I don’t remember doing anything clearly risky or impulsive during that time. I was just feeling really up and energized, but I can’t think of a specific behavior like that.
Have you experienced any hallucinations since you started feeling this heavy, hollow feeling?
No, I haven’t noticed anything like that since this started. I don’t think I’ve been seeing or hearing things that aren’t there.
Have you experienced any hallucinations or delusions since you started feeling this heavy, hollow feeling?
No, I don’t think so. I haven’t had hallucinations, and I don’t think I’ve believed things that weren’t real. It’s just been that heavy, empty feeling.
Have you experienced any hallucinations or delusions since your mood shifted and you started feeling this heavy, hollow feeling?
No, not that I can tell. I know you asked before, but I really haven’t noticed anything like hearing or seeing things, or believing something strange since this heavy feeling started.
Have you experienced any hallucinations or delusions since your mood shifted to this heavy, hollow feeling?
No, I still don’t think so. I haven’t noticed anything like that happening—nothing that felt like seeing or hearing things that weren’t there, or believing something that didn’t make sense.
Have you experienced any hallucinations or delusions since your mood shifted to this heavy, hollow feeling?
No, I haven’t noticed anything like that. I don’t think I’ve been seeing or hearing things, or believing things that aren’t real.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide since you started feeling this heavy, hollow feeling?
I’m not really sure how to answer that. I don’t think I’ve had anything clear like that, or at least nothing I’ve noticed enough to say yes.
Have you had any thoughts of death or suicide since you started feeling this heavy, hollow feeling?
I’m not sure. I wouldn’t say I’ve had clear thoughts about suicide or anything specific like that. Mostly I just know I feel really empty, but I haven’t noticed a definite thought of wanting to die.
